The Animal Pose Auditor found minimal risk (only 1 low-confidence keypoint at the ear), supporting structural integrity. I agree with the Router's severity ratings but note that the water texture issue is more of a 'realism' defect than a 'structural' artifact.

Background blur is excessive but plausible as bokeh. Slight compression artifacts were noted by the PQ auditor. No structural melting, extra limbs, or boundary fusion were detected by experts. The artifact score is lowered primarily due to the unnatural water texture and minor compression noise.
